offence_note: Sexual assault and break and enter of dwelling committed in 2001
sentence_quote: I sentence you to five years imprisonment for breaking and entering a dwelling house and committing an indictable offence contrary to s. 348(1)(d) of the Code; and five years imprisonment for sexual assault contrary to s. 271 of the Code; to be served concurrently.
note: Convicted after trial; no remorse; concurrent five years each count.

sentence_quote: An order will go from this court reducing the appellant's sentence by a further 10 weeks in recognition of the five weeks of pre-sentence custody he has already served.
note: Addendum: earlier reduced to two years less a day, then further 10 weeks off; final length not stated.

offence_note: Possession of stolen property, six tractor trailer loads worth $500,000
sentence_quote: The trial judge sentenced the appellant to 12 months' imprisonment plus three years' probation.
note: Leave granted, sentence appeal dismissed; mitigating factors described by court as present.

sentence_quote: We grant leave to appeal sentence, allow the appeal from sentence and substitute a sentence of time served (the equivalent of fifteen and a half months).
note: Original 36 months less 410 days credit; replaced by time served.

offence_note: Robbery with knife and failure to comply with probation
sentence_quote: the dangerous offender finding, and indeterminate sentence are set aside, and a new hearing is ordered.
note: Dangerous offender designation set aside; new hearing ordered.

offence_note: Criminal harassment and breach of probation
sentence_quote: I would only adjust the length of the sentence by reducing the term imposed for criminal harassment to a period of thirty-six months' incarceration
note: Six months concurrent for breach of probation; other trial orders undisturbed.

offence_note: Possession of fentanyl for the purpose of trafficking (about 1 kg)
sentence_quote: I am imposing a sentence of imprisonment of eight years.

offence_note: Sexual assault, sexual interference of child, possession of child pornography
sentence_quote: The trial judge imposed a global sentence of six years: five years for the sexual assault and sexual interference offences, and one year consecutive for possession of child pornography.
note: Child pornography coded sexual per definition; conviction appeals also dismissed.

sentence_quote: after 30 months' enhanced credit for the 20.5 months of pre-sentence custody, I would reduce his sentence to 12 months' imprisonment.
note: Only credit recalculated under Summers; 42 months total sentence unchanged.

sentence_quote: She is therefore sentenced to a two year term of incarceration for the robbery, and one month concurrent for the shoplifting.
note: Conditional sentence unavailable (serious personal injury offence); father of aboriginal descent, no Gladue discussion.
